name: Duck Maze
author: Julia Marques Sanches
description: You're a duck stuck in a maze: find your way through the corridors and get out. Arrows to move.

descriptions.en: You're a duck stuck in a maze: find your way through the corridors and get out. Arrows to move.
descriptions.it: Sei una papera intrappolata in un labirinto: trova la strada tra i corridoi e raggiungi l'uscita. Frecce per muoverti.
